title: GTA 6: 5 Things You Didn't Know (All Checked)
short_title_options: 5 GTA 6 facts most players don't know #GTA6 #Shorts
GTA 6 has a 99, no darts and Steve McQueen #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
1: GTA 6 scored 99 on Metacritic; only Zelda: Ocarina of Time also has a 99. 2: Rockstar cut darts and bowling (Rob Nelson to VGC); pool is in. 3: Jason was inspired by Steve McQueen in The Getaway (Rupert Humphries to Destructoid). 4: Trailer 1 (309.8M views, Nov 22) beats Trailer 2 and the launch trailer combined (280M). 5: After US inflation (BLS CPI), GTA 6's $79.99 is the cheapest main GTA at launch (GTA V was ~$86 in today's money). Which one surprised you?

Sources: Metacritic, VGC, GGRecon, Destructoid, GamesRadar, Rockstar's YouTube channel, BLS, OpenCritic.
